newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end higher, further upside seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end higher, further upside seen.

text.p: Austrian bonds ended stronger on Wednesday, on the back of German Bund future gains, traders said. The upward trend was expected to remain intact, albeit with the possibility of some correction, they noted.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 up five bps at 100.30 to yield 5.58 (5.59) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.20/28 to yield 5.60/5.59 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 up 10 bps at 100.30 to yield 4.55 (4.58) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.26/36 to yield 4.56/54 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 38 bps at 110.38 on turnover of 315 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany up one at five bps, five-year spread steady at 19 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.393 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
